items.html: No computed / templated bodies — a block body is authored static text; interpolation like {{ gate.config.value }} (which would close gate-vs-prose drift) is later → later
No semantic parity check — validate_context_refs proves a ref resolves, not that its prose matches the gate config it describes; drift is not detected → later
No rich context assembly — semantic retrieval, memory, skill-doc expansion, model-specific prompt shaping → §11.4
No actor-adapter rendering — context_blocks are kernel-level deterministic text; how an adapter folds them into a model-specific prompt is adapter work → later
No conditional block bodies — selection is by the authority predicate only; round- or state-dependent body variants are a computed-body concern → later
